target.statement: Unpruned inverse-square RTKNNC on variable-density blobs at K=8 yields ARI 0.7817 (4 clusters, 0 unclustered)
target.dataset: variable-density Gaussian blobs (synthetic, N=2000, 5 reference classes)

compute.basis: Single K=8 run on 2000 2-D points: KNN graph + closure is milliseconds-to-seconds; time is dominated by cloning repo, building the C binary (or running the Python port) and computing ARI.

title: Round-Trip KNN Clustering: multiscale hierarchical cluster detection on directed nearest-neighbour graphs
